messages:
Mike Chang: heads-up: onboarding LlamaX-13B-QLo. Need quick intake + mini-harness run. @Tara @Eli can you own prioritization?
Tara Patel: copying intake form answers in thread. primary workload: chat assistant, latency-sensitive. target p95 < 350ms on ded-s1.
Eli Johnson: noted. I'll queue a mini-harness: 3 prompt suites (safety, instruction-following, factuality). expected runtime ~30m.
Zoe Ramos: add regression fingerprinting — baseline from current prod-13b quant profile. we'll diff logits and ngram.
Mike Chang: mini-harness pass criteria idea: - Rouge-L/EM delta <= 1.0 relative to baseline - Safety fail rate not > 0.2% absolute - Latency increase < 15% at batch sizes 1/4. If any fail -> block. thoughts?
Tara Patel: agree. add an automated canary: deploy to 1% traffic with auto-fallback to prod-13b if any 5xx or latency spike >50% for 5m. :+1:
Eli Johnson: plan for steps: 1) fp16 run, 2) 8-bit PTQ, 3) 4-bit AWQ/QAT. We'll capture token-level divergences and sample outputs for manual review.
Zoe Ramos: EvalBot: kicked off mini-harness: run_id=mh-1714079123. Command:
```bash
./run_eval.sh --suite mini-onboard --model LlamaX-13B-QLo --out /tmp/mh-1714079123
```
EvalBot: job queued on runner-42. ETA ~28m.
Eli Johnson: adding a quick diff script to attach to artifacts:
```python
# diff example
with open('baseline.json') as b, open('candidate.json') as c:
    # compute ngram delta and top-k logit diffs
    pass
```
Tara Patel: priority = P1 for next week (customer trials). add a checklist: 1) security scan, 2) QA prompt sets, 3) perf on dedicated nodes, 4) signal hooks + alerting.
Mike Chang: ok locking criteria. If mini-harness passes -> move to canary 1% with 24h stability run and quality sampling. If canary passes -> staged 10% 48h -> full rollout.
Zoe Ramos: quick note: collect eval artifacts to s3://redwood-evals/1714079123/ and tag with model:lmx-13b-qlo, quant:4bit if applicable.
Eli Johnson: will post results here when done.
EvalBot: mh-1714079123 status: running (12m elapsed).
Mike Chang: thanks all. If anyone sees odd hallucination patterns, flag with sample id + prompt. :eyes:
